children: UK connected tech provider's H1 revenue was flat yr/yr at £3.4 mln
Adjusted EBITDA turned positive in H1, while pre-tax loss was unchanged
Company expects slightly weaker H2 revenue amid economic uncertainty
Touchstar expects H2 2026 revenue to be slightly weaker than H1 2026
Company anticipates full-year 2026 loss will be lower than current market expectation
Touchstar maintains expectation of returning to profitability in 2027
LOGISTICS PORTFOLIO SIMPLIFICATION - Co said ceasing standalone development and marketing of PODStar has concentrated investment and clarified logistics capabilities
ENGINEERING LEADERSHIP - Appointment of Head of Engineering has improved product roadmap ownership and delivery capacity
SALES MODEL REDESIGN - Internal sales model was redesigned to improve customer coverage, cross-selling and reduce reliance on individual account managers
